label: Wholly-good sense controls: only WHOLLY_GOOD_1 yields Rowe's permission constraint
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. (1) With the outcome bridge, a constraint-respecting wholly good omniscient omnipotent being can face unblocked preventable suffering whose only way of prevention has the footbridge structure, so WHOLLY_GOOD_2 does not yield Rowe's simplified constraint. (2) Under the qualified condition, one constraint-free way of preventing restores Rowe's blocking-cost requirement (easy rescue survives). (3) Reading WhollyGood as supreme ontological goodness that wills some good to every existing being (WHOLLY_GOOD_3) is consistent with an omniscient omnipotent bearer and failure of the constraint. (4) WHOLLY_GOOD_1 without the outcome bridge does not yield it. (5) The constraint clause classifies switch, side-effect and harmless ways as constraint-free and footbridge, transplant and loop ways as violating.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Select a sense of WhollyGood for the case's GOD_4 bearer on a carrier shared with Rowe's signature (the planned bridge of STMT-ROWE-NO-THEISTIC-BEING). Under WHOLLY_GOOD_1 with the outcome bridge, STMT-ROWE-PERMISSION-CONSTRAINT follows; under WHOLLY_GOOD_2 only the constraint-qualified permission condition follows, so Rowe's core would additionally need that some constraint-free way of preventing the suffering exists; under WHOLLY_GOOD_3 neither follows.
connection_plan.blocker: No warranted identification of Rowe's WhollyGood with any of the three senses for the case bearer exists. The outcome bridge is open (several individually lesser costs may jointly outweigh a suffering), divine permission versus intention is owned by issue #1456, and the bearer bridge by issue #1735.
